reason: I would take the free 15-company list, because it costs me nothing and gives me something concrete to put in front of my partner. But paying EUR 1,600 has to go through my partner, and that will not happen inside a month for an agency that found me the same way the other three cold pitches a week do.
objection: One logistics client with 45 meetings is a story, not proof. I am a wholesaler. I do not know if these people understand my buyers, or if the meetings will turn into orders and not just calls that waste my time.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies shows buyers I did not already know, and I can speak to a wholesaler or distributor client in my region who got real orders from it, my partner would sign off on the pilot.
